description.value: The London Pub is a late-night bar and public house on Main Street in Vancouver, named 'Simply the Best Late Night Bar in Vancouver' by The Georgia Straight. It operates as a cocktail and craft-beer bar with an in-house Brooklyn-style pizza kitchen offering a wide range of pies including vegan options. The venue hosts events and accepts reservations, making it a lively urban stop for cyclists exploring East Vancouver.
